141-3085-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-4247.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Naru Meha, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7511-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
6972-7511-8095.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

586-3375-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-3375-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

250-779-1479-5414-7889.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-7889.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5414-7889.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-5660-6462-7368-7824.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3734-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-4871-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-6968-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-6968-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

647-1368-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
647-1368-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1172-1624-7735.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

457-1458-4404-7692.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-7692.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Shuri.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

5220-6505-6634-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

527-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 8 or greater.
527-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {7}{G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

240-3967-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2811-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1358-1978-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1358-1978-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Sydri.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

2741-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

386-6714.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block the creature that has Super State and Glistening Oil attached.
The creature with Super State and Glistening Oil attached has power 10 or greater, or each opponent has at least one poison counter.
386-6714.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Super State and Glistening Oil attached, causing the opponent it was attacking to get at least ten poison counters. The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Super State triggers, causing the creature to cause each opponent to get at least ten poison counters. The opponents lose the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

4525-5739.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 30.
4525-5739.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Palisade Giant causes that damage to be redirected to it.
Since Caduceus grants an ability to Palisade Giant preventing damage being dealt to it, no damage is dealt to you or to that creature.

2793-3129-3743-5089-5435.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3129-3743-5089-5435.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

803-1429-2921-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-2921-5402.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

359-372-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-4823.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3372-4885-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4885-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1238-2292-2351-4452-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-4862-5627.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4862-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-4862-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

719-1486-2494-3459.description:
Activate Dwarven Bloodboiler by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the Dwarven Bloodboiler ability, giving target creature +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming

1495-3531-4613.notablePrerequisites: Vessel of the All-Consuming has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-3531-4613.description:
Activate Vessel of the All-Consuming using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vessel of the All-Consuming's first ability triggers, as well as its second ability if it has dealt 10 or more damage to the opponent this turn.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Vessel of the All-Consuming.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing the opponent to lose the game.
Repeat.

3047-4050-4125.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {B}.
When Shipwreck Dowser dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

567-4186-4384.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-4186-4384.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3478-4913-5310.notablePrerequisites: Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3478-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4050-4499-4749.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Somberwald Beastmaster.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, 3/3 Beast and 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Wolf and two Beasts, adding {3}.
Repeat.

248-380-4284.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Miirym.
Resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger, championing Clone.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a copy of Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Berserker.
The nontoken Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning Clone from exile to the battlefield as a copy of the Changeling Berserker token.
Clone enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Miirym.
Resolve the Clone trigger, championing the token Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Berserker from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all remaining Miirym triggers, creating infinite nonlegendary copies of Clone that can copy any creatures you control.

712-4091.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
712-4091.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping itself.
Wake Thrasher triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2178-2518-4096.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goblin Welder.
You control a nontoken artifact creature.
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2518-4096.description:
Tap Goblin Welder, targeting the artifact creature on the battlefield and Perilous Myr in your graveyard.
The artifact creature is sacrificed and Perilous Myr enters the battlefield.
Goblin Welder triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Goblin Welder again, targeting the artifact creature in your graveyard and Perilous Myr on the battlefield.
The artifact creature returns to the battlefield and Perilous Myr is sacrificed.
Goblin Welder triggers, untapping itself.
Perilous Myr triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat for infinite damage.

2492-3105-3368.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the Pyretic Ritual copy, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Pyretic Ritual.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Reiterate.
Resolve the Reiterate copy, creating a copy of Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the second Pyretic Ritual copy, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the first copy of Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.
